notes.sowing: Start seed indoors 8 to 12 weeks before planting out, {cm:1.3} deep. Plant transplants or sets 2 to 4 weeks before your last frost, sets {cm:2} deep with the tips showing. Small sets bolt less than large ones.
notes.care: Bulbs form in response to day length: choose long-day types for high latitudes, short-day types near the tropics, and intermediate types in between. Plants need plenty of leaf before bulbing starts, so plant early, keep weeded, and stop watering once bulbs swell.
notes.harvest: Lift when about half the tops have fallen over. Cure in a warm, airy, dry place for 2 to 4 weeks until the necks are tight, then store cool and dry.
